deltas_from_v21: No carried prediction value changed. P17 is recorded as KILLED as registered. P41 added after the kill.

P17 kill (chapter 43.74): the registered kill 'cosmological upper bound below 55 meV at 95% CL' names no model or prior; read literally it is met by arXiv:2606.17994 (CMB-SPA + DESI DR2 BAO + DES Y5, LambdaCDM, prior from 0, adiabatic): sum m_nu < 52 meV. The same bound also excludes the oscillation minimum 58.79 meV (CE is 0.37 meV above it). Other readings: isocurvature 57, hierarchy prior 92, CPL 111, DESI DR2 + Planck PR4 64.2 meV. JUNO first results keep P19 (-0.81 sigma) and P03 (+1.07 sigma).

Post-hoc context, not a rescue: G1m (43.49, set before this kill) lowers the BAO Omega_m reading by 0.0099, about -81 meV in sum m_nu at fixed theta* (dOm/dSum = 0.122 per eV, rough). This motivates the separate P41.

E4 identifications (43.73, reading): the confining group's coupling is a capture-record probability (a^3); the broken group leaves a rotation amplitude (2a^2); one coin. Explains why alpha_2 != a^2. E4 stays an axiom.
